AKTU State-Level Sports Fest — The Pride of the State at GCET, Greater Noida

Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College (AKGEC) proudly celebrates a remarkable achievement as Team AKGEC clinched the Overall Winner Trophy at the AKTU State-Level Sports Fest — “The Pride of the State”, held across eight zones at Galgotias College of Engineering and Technology (GCET), Greater Noida, on 6–7 November 2025.

AKGEC athletes showcased exceptional skill and determination, securing 6 Gold, 2 Silver, and 1 Bronze Medal at the state-level event. Earlier, AKGEC had emerged as the Overall Champion from the Ghaziabad Zone during the AKTU Sports Zonal Fest, hosted by RKGIT on 16–17 October 2025, with an impressive 26 medals — 9 Gold, 15 Silver, and 2 Bronze among 21 participating colleges.

These consecutive triumphs stand as a testament to AKGEC’s unwavering spirit of discipline, teamwork, and excellence. The AKGEC fraternity extends heartfelt congratulations to the entire Sports Team for this outstanding accomplishment and for being recognized as the Best Sports Team in AKTU.
Sports fest UDGHOSH’25 at IIT Kanpur

AKGEC teams proudly participated in the prestigious sports fest UDGHOSH’25 at IIT Kanpur, showcasing remarkable spirit, teamwork, and determination. Some victories were ours, some lessons were learned — but every moment reflected passion, unity, and true sportsmanship. Each player carried the pride of AKGEC, competing with unwavering dedication and enthusiasm. Their efforts, both on and off the field, proved that success is not only measured by medals but also by giving our best and growing together as a team.
AKTU Sports Zonal Fest 2025 held at RKGIT

Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College proudly celebrates a remarkable sports achievement as Team AKGEC clinched the Overall Championship Trophy at the AKTU Sports Zonal Fest held at RKGIT, excelling among 21 participating colleges. Our athletes demonstrated outstanding discipline, determination, and sportsmanship, securing an impressive total of 26 medals — 8 Gold, 16 Silver, and 2 Bronze across multiple events, including Table Tennis, Kho-Kho, Kabaddi, Volleyball, Basketball, Badminton, Track & Field, and Relay competitions. From relay victories and outstanding performances in long jump, discus throw, and shot put to strong showings in high jump and sprint events, each achievement reflects the unwavering commitment and passion of our talented students. This triumph stands as a testament to their hard work and to the tireless support and guidance provided by our dedicated faculty mentors and sports coordinators, bringing immense pride and glory to AKGEC.
AKTU State Level Sports Fest 2024

Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College (AKGEC) showcased outstanding talent and sportsmanship at the State-level Sports Fest, hosted by Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam Technical University at Shri Ramswaroop College of Engineering and Management (SRMCEM) in Lucknow from November 12 to November 13, 2024. The college’s teams achieved a commendable 10 gold, 3 silver, and 2 bronze medals, earning accolades for their formidable skills and commitment.

AKGEC won the highest number of gold medals in the AKTU State Sports Fest 2024-25 under the Ghaziabad zone. With this performance, AKGEC contributed to Ghaziabad zone’s decade-long winning streak in the AKTU State Sports Fest. AKGEC also claimed the prestigious title of “Best State Sports Team,” standing out among the eight participating zones.
AKGEC takes immense pride in its sports team, who consistently demonstrate hard work, dedication, and sportsmanship on state stage.
AKTU Sports Fest 2024

We are thrilled to announce our students’ outstanding performance at the AKTU Literary, Management, and Technical Zonal Fest, held at KIET on 27th–28th November 2024.They won silver medals in 10 events, including Robo Race, Robo Wars, Debate, INNO Quest, and Turbo AI Challenge, and bronze medals in Declamation and Ad Mad Show, earning medals in every event they participated in. Congratulations to our talented students for their dedication, hard work, and exceptional achievements!
AKTU Sports, Cultural and Technical fests 2023

We are proud to announce the outstanding performance and dedication of AKGEC students in the AKTU Zonal Sports Fest-2023 held on November 3-4, 2023, at RKGIT Ghaziabad. Winning 9 gold medals, 8 silver medals, and 9 bronze medals is a remarkable achievement, and it reflects the hard work and talent of the sports team of AKGEC.

Even more impressive is the fact that Team AKGEC secured the Overall Championship Trophy in the Ghaziabad Zone with a total of 26 medals. Being the highest among all participating colleges is a testament to the exceptional skills and teamwork of AKGEC's sports team. This accomplishment not only showcases the sporting prowess of the students but also the dedication and commitment of the institution in promoting sports and excellence.

Such achievements in sports play a crucial role in fostering a sense of pride and unity within the institution and inspire others to excel in their respective fields. Once again, congratulations to all the winners and to AKGEC for its overall victory in the competition!
AKTU State Level Sports Fest 2023
Congratulations to the AKGEC sports team for their outstanding performance in the AKTU State Level Sports Fest 2023 held during 1st to 2nd December 2023 at SRIMT, Lucknow.

AKGEC won 4 Gold Medals and 1 Silver Medal, top amongst all colleges and contributed for the Ghaziabad Zone’s Overall Championship with 7 Gold Medal and 1 Silvers Medal. This is a remarkable achievement and a testament to the team's hard work, dedication, and skill. Kudos to the athletes, coaches, and everyone involved in this incredible achievement! It's moments like these that create a strong sense of camaraderie and showcase the power of teamwork and perseverance.

AKTU Sports, Cultural and Technical fests 2018-19

Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College always focuses on empowering students and providing students an opportunity to pursue their talents. The college organised the AKTU Technical, Literary and Management Zonals with the aim of supporting students to pursue their passions and excel in extra-curricular activities as they continue to excel academically.

The zonals were hosted on 30 & 31 January, 2019. More than 19 colleges in the Ghaziabad – Modinagar zone actively participated in the two day long techno-manegerial fest. A total of 336 students, 264 boys and 72 girls, participated in 11 events that was organised by the various college societies.

The various events organised were Bridge Kriti, Robowar, RoboRace, Frugal Engineering, Check your knowledge, Just a Minute, English Debate, Hindi Debate, Business plan, Coding contest and Technical poster making.

Director, Dr. RK Agarwal conferred awards to the winning students and teams during the award ceremony on 31 January, 2019. The winners will be participating in the States round in Lucknow on 15-16 February, 2019.

The overall championship was won by Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College as the students bagged a total of 12 Gold Medals. The Runners Up trophy was awarded to IPEC for their amazing performance in the zonals taking home 4 Gold Medals.

The event was organised under the guidance of Dean Student Welfare, Prof. V K Parashar for his valuable help and support. The event was organised and managed by the student convenors Kunal, Shivam Chaudhary, Yash Saxena and Eeshank Karnwal under the guidance of Dean Student Welfare.
